senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced. wds.); pl. תְּכָכִים middle, mean; איש ת׳ a man of medium wealth, of some means.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:4">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 29:13">Ps. XXIX, 13</cite>) <he>רש זה שהוא רש בתורה ואיש ת׳ וכ׳</he> ‘poor’ means poor of knowledge, and the ‘man of means’, that is he who has learned one or two orders (of the Mishnah); <he>עמד רש עם איש ת׳ וכ׳</he> the ignorant comes to the scholarly man, saying, teach me &c.; <he>רש … בנכסים ואיש ת׳ זה שהוא עושה בפעולה</he> ‘poor’ means poor of possessions, and ‘the man of means’, that is he who works with success; <he>עמד רש עם איש ת׳ וכ׳</he> the poor man comes to the successful man &c.; Yalk. ib. 665 <he>איש ת׳ זה שהוא בינוני מן הנכסים</he> he who is of medium wealth (v.
